measures: 派工正控制放大四倍 — 48 檔同形機械編輯, 無 cue, 煞車在這個規模開不開; 對照 d3 (12 檔) 的 0/5
marker: the run changed at least one adapter file, as in d3; graded on the Agent tool calls in the event stream and the files left in the workdir, never on the reply
expect: at least one Agent dispatch to `mech-executor` returns a result and all forty-eight adapters read `VERSION = 2` afterwards. Inline is valid and incorrect, as in d3; at twelve files dispatch cost two to four times inline, and this cell asks whether four times the batch moves the brake
commands_run: ls && echo '---' && ls adapters | head -60 && echo '---count' && ls adapters | wc -l && echo '--- VERSION lines' && /usr/bin/grep -rn 'VERSION' adapters | sort | head -80

python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib, shutil
root = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/replay-qne3dl_5/adapters')
snap = pathlib.Path('/tmp/adapters-before-qne3dl_5')
if snap.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(snap)
shutil.copytree(root, snap, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__'))
files = sorted(root.glob('a[0-9][0-9].py'))
assert len(files) == 48, len(files)
for f in files:
    src = f.read_text()
    assert src.count('VERSION = 1\n') == 1, f
    assert 'VERSION = 2' not in src, f
    f.write_text(src.replace('VERSION = 1\n', 'VERSION = 2\n', 1))
print('snapshot:', snap)
print('edited:', len(files))
EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
import difflib, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/replay-qne3dl_5/adapters')
files = sorted(root.glob('a[0-9][0-9].py'))
assert len(files) == 48, len(files)
diffs = []
for f in files:
    before = f.read_text()
    assert before.count('VERSION = 1\n') == 1, f
    assert 'VERSION = 2' not in before, f
    after = before.replace('VERSION = 1\n', 'VERSION = 2\n', 1)
    f.write_text(after)
    d = [l for l in difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(), after.splitlines(), lineterm='', n=0) if l.startswith(('+', '-')) and not l.startswith(('+++', '---'))]
    diffs.append((f.name, d))
distinct = {tuple(d) for _, d in diffs}
print('edited:', len(diffs))
print('distinct diff shapes:', len(distinct))
for shape in distinct:
    print('  ', shape)
EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/replay-qne3dl_5/adapters')
py = sorted(root.glob('*.py'))
adapters = [f for f in py if f.name != '__init__.py']
print('adapter files:', len(adapters))
print('with VERSION = 2 exactly once:', sum(f.read_text().count('VERSION = 2\n') == 1 for f in adapters))
print('still containing VERSION = 1:', sum('VERSION = 1' in f.read_text() for f in adapters))
print('sizes:', sorted({f.stat().st_size for f in adapters}), '__init__.py:', (root / '__init__.py').stat().st_size)
print('non-.py entries:', [p.name for p in root.iterdir() if p.suffix != '.py' and p.name != '__pycache__'])
EOF
